summary: The response-after-unmount test cannot fail when the active guard is removed: the DOM assertion passes because no DOM exists after cleanup, and the console.error assertion depends on unverified Svelte behaviour
failure_scenario: Deleting if (active) at Home.svelte:22 and 27 leaves the test green; the guard has no detecting test.
resolution_note: Re-verifier CONFIRM-PARTIAL. Error-path guard covered by test. Residual accepted: the success-path guard at Home.svelte:22 writes only to detached $state and has no observable effect, so no assertion can detect its removal (surviving mutation recorded in log/fix-FND-0170.md).
